preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of allowed letters p must be between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == s[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The string s must not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NO' or a string of length n consisting of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(stdout[i] != stdout[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', it must not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout > s and all(stdout[i] <= stdout[i+1] for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', it must be lexicographically larger than the input string s and must be the lexicographically smallest tolerable string larger than s.
